findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/holdout-record.js::writer checks judged ids but not each row's class against faff dod classify in buildholdoutrecord
findings.title: writer checks judged ids but not each row's class against faff dod classify in buildHoldoutRecord
findings.action: None in this ticket; a class cross-check against classify could be a later hardening ticket.
findings.disposition_rationale: Not a new fail-open path. The evaluator's verdict on a judged row is trusted by design (spec: the writer never recomputes aggregate, verdict or evidence_present). An evaluator willing to relabel a prose Scenarios unit as scenario/met can just as easily fabricate met evidence on a real scenario, so a class check closes no capability. The self-declared class is also what main trusts today, and this diff only tightens the writer (id-set completeness). Optional hardening, not a defect of this diff.

occurrences.title: writer checks judged ids but not each row's class against faff dod classify in buildHoldoutRecord
